outcome: CS rates in Robson groups 1, 2, and 5
cohort: The study included all births in Estonia (n = 356,063) and Finland (n = 1,437,234) between 1992 and 2016.
finding: In Estonia, the proportion of CSs significantly increased from 6.5% to 21.0%, while in Finland it increased moderately from 15.1% to 16.8% between 1992 and 2016.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean sections as a mode of birth increased in both Estonia (from 6.5% to 21.0%) and Finland (from 15.1% to 16.8%) between 1992 and 2016.
